chunks: And among them is al-Mufaddal ibn Umar

key_terms.المفضل بن عمر: Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar, a prominent companion and emissary of the Imams
key_terms.وهم: Among them, indicating inclusion in a previously mentioned group

ai.seo_question: Who is al-Mufaddal ibn Umar in the context of the Imam's emissaries?
ai.summary: Al-Mufall ibn Umar is introduced as a key figure among the four prominent emissaries (al-nuwwab al-arba'a) who served as intermediaries between the Hidden Imam and the Shia community during the Minor Occultation. His inclusion underscores the structured transmission of religious authority and legal guidance through trusted companions, a concept central to Twelver Shia jurisprudence and the doctrine of the Four Deputies.
